markdown:
# Tabs

You might say
There's too much content here. Split it into tabs so people can switch views with a click.

**Switch between a few peer sections on the same page**·Tabs work for sections such as Overview, Settings, and Logs under the same object. Keep the active tab obvious and decide whether unfinished input remains when switching. If the sections are really separate destinations, use navigation instead.

## You can say this to an AI Agent

> “
> Use tabs for Overview, Members, and Logs inside project details and always show the active tab. Preserve appropriate section state and test mouse, keyboard, and narrow-screen behavior.

### When to use it

- Sections of one record

AllAwaiting paymentCompleted
- Switch between related views

OverviewSettingsLogs
- Organize a compact settings page

CommentsHistorySave
No navigation needed—click to switch content.
- Separate content that shares the same context

AllIn progressFinish

### When NOT to use it

- Use tabs for the product's main navigation

1Enter information2Confirm order3Complete payment
- Create so many tabs that they no longer fit

AllFrontendBackendDesignOperationsProductTestingData
Tabs that do not fit disappear.
- Hide required steps behind optional-looking tabs

Two columns for side-by-side comparison.
- Discard unsaved input silently when switching
